call.x: A new call focusing on Wildfire Preparedness opened on 1 September 2026. The earlier Wildfire Response call closed on 2 June 2026. Introduction This is part of the Wildfire Safety initiative, inviting proposals for innovative services that advance wildfire management using space technology and data. The first call focused on Wildfire Response, supporting solutions for early detection of wildfires, near-real-time fire evolution monitoring, and fire behaviour simulation and prediction. A subsequent call focusing on Wildfire Preparedness will open on 1 September 2026, and will address wildfire risk assessment, fuel load management, and the application of preventative and adaptation measures....
n: Run by European Space Agency (ESA). The organiser sets the rules; Eligible Calls reads this call from ESA Business Applications funding (business.esa.int).

HE-GA-B.title: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027, General Annexes, B - Eligibility

consortium.quote: Unless otherwise provided for in the specific call/topic conditions, only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions provided that the consortium includes, as beneficiaries, three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country as follows: – at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and – at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries.
